name: Magic Moment
summary: Yi Tong thought that she's very tough. She wouldn't yield to her mother but she yielded to love. After losing a mother's love, she put all her hope in love. But mockingly, love abandoned her. But her mother still cooked for her and waited for her at home. When she ran back to her mother's side, what awaited her was just the cold body and her dead mother. Yi Tong decided to face her regrets by using the time capsule her mother left behind to help her mother fulfil her regrets in life.

name: Revenge
summary: After a mother and her daughter are gang-raped by seven men, the daughter suffers a mental breakdown, and the single mom sets out to get revenge.

name: Маска
summary:
Channel "Ukraine" presents the second season of the grand star detective show "MASK", which will be attended by Ukrainian stars - actors, musicians, comedians, athletes, politicians, presenters and singers. But their personalities are a mystery!

In the second season of the grandiose project "MASK" viewers will get acquainted with twenty completely new heroes. Bright and unforgettable images in which the stars will appear on stage - a real work of art. Unique costumes are prepared by hand by a whole team of style - designer, artist, designer-technologist, seamstresses.

The secrecy of the show is provided by a special security team. The host and the film crew do not even guess who may be hiding under the mysterious costumes.

name: Metro Sexual
summary: Hilarious Australian sit-com gives you a peek behind the doctor's curtain at a small local sexual health clinic and their wacky employees. Uncomfortable doctor visits have never been so funny.

name: Open Homes Australia
summary: Dynamic renovation duo- Michael & Carlene Duffy bring you some of Australia's most inspirational homes and gardens, whilst reporting some top insider design tips and tricks along the way.

name: Our Musical History
summary: A seven part series, each episode focuses on a different genre of music, from blues to soul to disco to country, with some of its leading practitioners going through their favourite tunes and moments, helping us to appreciate which makes each genre special.

name: Євродиректор
summary: What happens if a teacher from the Netherlands suddenly becomes a principal in an ordinary Ukrainian school? We don't know for sure, so it will be interesting to watch it. Daniel Jansen is the "European director", and in a year he should turn the school in Kryvopil into a modern European educational institution.

name: Батько рулить
summary: A father with many children stays in charge instead of his wife and understands that being the head of a large family is more difficult than it seemed before

name: Прибулець
summary: An alien due to an accident on a spaceship gets to Earth in a Ukrainian family and tries to adapt to new living conditions and understand humanity.

name: My Wonderful Roommate
summary: A story about a breathtaking and thrilling office romance between Lee Eun Jung, who lives with a friend from her childhood, and Jung Jae Hoon, her old friend and team leader at Eun Jung's workplace.

name: Beauty and the Bitches
summary: Beauty pageant contestants from all over Thailand fight for the crown as they contend with drama and intrigue behind the scenes.

name: Lovey Dovey
summary: When two brothers fall for two sisters, they quickly realize the age differences between them are too big to ignore.

name: Your Garden Made Perfect
summary:
We all think we know how the inside of our homes should look, but most of us have absolutely no idea what to do outside. Your Garden Made Perfect gives home-owners the opportunity to see their outside spaces transformed into breathtaking wonderlands, before they are created in real life.

Using the latest visual technologies, radically different designs are showcased digitally, allowing people to see what their garden could look like before a wheelbarrow is filled or a tree uprooted. As well as big budgets and mega plots, there are also clever low-cost reinventions of small spaces too, packed with tips and tricks to inspire people at home to get stuck in themselves.

name: Behind the Newsroom
summary: Confident and cool under pressure, top news presenter Punchalee meets her match in the conniving Dao, who'll stop at nothing to fulfill her ambitions.

name: Bangkok Bachelors
summary: Three young men leading carefree bachelors' lives in the city face the trials of true love when they meet three beautiful women.

name: Melodies of Life - Born This Way
summary: A celebrated pastry chef and his fellow staff members at a bake shop embark on bittersweet adventures in love, work and friendship.

name: Castle of Stars
summary: As four couples with different lifestyles go through the ebbs and flows of joy and sorrow, each must learn how to live a good life.

name: Belle Collective
summary: Belle Collective centers on the personal and professional lives of five successful, glamourous boss women who are redefining what it means to be a southern belle in Jackson, Mississippi. These dynamic women represent Mississippi's finest Black female entrepreneurs, determined to break ceilings–glass and otherwise–while shredding long-held stereotypes of the South. They must set aside their differences to redevelop a struggling mid-twentieth century historic district that was once known as the hub for Black-owned businesses.

name: Exhumed
summary: The series examines a gripping murder case in which unearthing a victim's body is the key to solving the twisted crime. Each episode features a suspenseful exhumation that has led to shocking new breakthroughs, unexpected plot-twists, and ultimately, justice being served.

name: Ghost Adventures: Top 10
summary: Zak Bagans counts down fans' favorite moments from Ghost Adventures. It's a fun yet terrifying walk down memory lane as Zak revisits the scariest, funniest and most insane clips from episodes past and presents some of the crew's best paranormal evidence.

name: Drag Race Down Under
summary: Drag queen contestants compete in an elimination-style contest and strut their stuff in a variety of challenges - all to prove that they've got what it takes to be Down Under's next Drag Queen Superstar!

name: The Wild Life of Dr. Ole
summary: Dr. Ole Alcumbrac owns White Mountain Animal Hospital, a full-service animal clinic in Pinetop, Arizona, that cares for everything from cats and dogs to exotics and large animals. But this self-described 'wild man' isn't your typical veterinarian, and it's his work outside of the clinic that excites him most.

name: FOOLs - Những Kẻ Khờ
summary: FOOLs - Những Kẻ Khờ brings you back to the final moments of the path called youth before the turning point of life. There is joy, sorrow, and remains aching is the feeling of regret. Regrets held in the late confession, in the selfish decisions. Regrets in the one sided love that cannot seem to put into words.

name: The Outlaw
summary: Because of the brutal killing of his family, making the young engineer take revenge without waiting for the justice system. But due to carelessness, he is arrested for murdering the father of a woman he secretly loves and is sent to train as an assassin of a secret organization that eliminates evil people illegally. There was a turn of event when he realized he was being used so he decided to withdraw and expose the organization's evil plans. With his own life and his loved one at stake.

name: LEGO Masters
summary: Ambitious building block fans of all ages can put their skills to the test in the show. With access to over a million Lego bricks, candidates can show that they are unbeatable in originality, skill and perseverance. After a season moderated by Oliver Geissen, which was shown the evening before, Daniel Hartwich took over the moderation of the show, which will now run in prime time.

name: LEGO Masters
summary: French version of the international game show, a LEGO building contest! The show is hosted by magician and comedian Eric Antoine, who oversees eight pairs of builders as they face off in a series of brick-based challenges.

name: Let's Fight Ghost
summary: A med student with a supernatural gift tries to cash in on his abilities by facing off against ghosts, until a wandering spirit brings romance instead.

name: LEGO Masters
summary: Teams of two LEGO enthusiasts compete to build the best Lego project. In each episode, participants will have to face tasks and create spectacular structures from Lego bricks. It will test the participants' abilities, creativity, imagination and technical skills. At the end of each episode, the weakest couple will leave the show. The best 3 pairs will compete for the final and it will be a real clash of the champions! The winner will receive the title of Lego Master and a prize of PLN 100,000!

name: Breaking Even
summary: The technology group Lindemann is testing self-driving cars that are about to be launched on the market. One evening a woman dies on an unauthorized test drive. A lawyer and a dropout want to clarify the case.

name: Reality of Dream
summary: Five friends from college chase their post-grad dreams of becoming a successful writer, film director, singer, rich wife and out-and-proud hair stylist.

name: Fatal Destiny
summary: A young man from a humble family is drawn into a life of crime and soon confronts a determined cop in hot pursuit.

name: Accidental Daddy
summary: A successful DJ's bachelor life is turned upside down when a young woman arrives, claiming to be his long lost daughter.

name: Onze Straat
summary: Everyone meets each other on the street. People live, work and make contact in the street. It is a place where different generations and cultures grapple with today's issues. There is a different story behind every door.

name: Code van Coppens
summary: In a race against time, two duos of famous Dutch people search for clues in specially built spectacular escape rooms. Who will be the first to crack the code and be able to leave the room?

name: Mijn Leven in Hun Handen
summary: Seven people who suffer from severe and sometimes special illnesses are followed for a year. They live towards an all-important medical procedure.

name: Sundby mot verden
summary: The challenges are in line for Martin Johnsrud Sundby in the World Cup season. Can he really defend his gold?

name: Bucket List with The Boz
summary: Bucket List with The Boz follows outspoken college football legend, Brian "The Boz" Bosworth, as he tours eight of the best destinations in college football today, interviewing coaches, former star players and fans to determine why each stadium deserves a spot on every fan's bucket list.

name: Detective in the House
summary: An engineer gives up his lucrative career to become a private detective.

name: Grand Designs Sverige
summary: Meet hopeful house enthusiasts and follow along as they build their dream home. Magnificent architecture, incomparable surroundings and innovative ideas await when no vision is too difficult to realize. Architecture critic Mark Isitt guides us through the process, from the very first sod to the last.

name: Marvel Battleworld: Mystery of the Thanostones
summary: When Iron Man is sent to Thanos' newly assembled Battleworld, he discovers there is an odd assortment of heroes there, too. Can Iron Man and this rag-tag group – Captain Marvel, Spider-Ham, Groot, and Throg – figure out what the Mad Titan wants and why they've been brought to this strange, new world?

name: Cidade Invisível
summary: An environmental police officer uncovers a hidden world of mythological entities from Brazilian folklore when he finds a connection between the mysterious appearance of a dead river dolphin on a Rio de Janeiro beach and the death of his beloved wife.

name: Norges største bankraner
summary: Martin Pedersen was the rich boy who was to become an actor, but who ended up becoming «Norges største bankraner» (Norway's biggest bank robber). The series illuminates a unique Norwegian crime story, not only told by the perpetrator himself, but also by the police who hunted him, and the ransom victims who remained.

name: Snefrid og Erik blir influensere
summary: Show about Snefrid Antonsen (64) and Erik Hagen (67) becoming influencers.

name: Britannia Hotel
summary: We follow the work of planning, renovation, large-scale opening and eventually daily operation of the spectacular hotel and meeting place Britannia Hotel. Viewers not only meet Odd Reitan, but also get to know many of the personalities who play an important role in making Britannia the extraordinary hotel of their dreams.

name: Miss Monte-Cristo
summary: A suspenseful revenge drama about a woman whose life was destroyed by the friends she trusted most. After making up her mind to take revenge on those who betrayed her, she returns to reclaim the life that was stolen from her.

name: Helt Harald
summary: Throughout his life, Harald Rønneberg has done things he cannot. Now he will get to know really well with a bunch of inspiring Norwegians, and together they will complete eight challenges Harald has dreamed of for a long time. Because as he usually says: There is a limit to how much shit can go!

name: Ekspedisjon Lothepus
summary: After the success of Farmen, and the fight against cancer, Lothepus is ready for new adventures. After Fjorden Cowboys, we meet a more reflective man, who dreams of following in the footsteps of the pioneers. In each episode of Expedition Lothepus, our hero and a famous guest are on a trip to a new destination. There are hard-hitting activities, challenges and discussions about life around the campfire.

name: Krigerhjerte
summary: Henriette Vasstrand is the Norwegian champion in boxing who lived with intoxication and violence. Now she will follow others out of intoxication. It was much tougher than she had thought.

name: LOVER
summary: Mikka and Noah do not know each other, they are in their early 20s and are desperately chasing the perfect life in their own way. They take drugs to perform better and escape from everyday life, but now the price is getting too high.

previousepisode.name: Hvis jeg ikke havde OD'et havde jeg aldrig mødt dig

name: Yeşilçam
summary: Showcasing Turkey of the 1960s, while it follows a film producer who will tell the story of survival in Yeşilçam as he experiences the golden age of Turkish cinema.

name: Wan Wan Celeb Soreyuke! Tetsunoshin
summary: The Inuyama Family, along with their pet dog Tetsunoshin moves to the famous Hoppongi Hills (modeled after Roppongi Hills) from Kyushu. Rumi Inuyama's father owns an IT Company in Japan and is a step further to becoming number one. However, Tetsunoshin learned that his master's family loaned a lot of money renting their home in Hoppongi Hills, almost to the point of the whole company becoming Bankrupt. To make things even worse, the whole family spends a lot of money on everything, making Tetsunoshin's problems worse. To solve this problem, Tetsunoshin teamed up with the Hills Dogs and will do anything to pay all the Inuyama Family's expenses.

name: Tropical-Rouge! Pretty Cure
summary: Manatsu Natsumi is a first year middle school student who alongside her family has moved to Aozora City from Minamino Island. She begins her new life there and her first semester in middle school until one day, she met with a strange person named Laura, a mermaid who had originated in a mystical place called Grand Ocean, the land of Mermaids. She has been searching for legendary warriors in her legends who can stand up against the Dark Witch from the bottom of the ocean that took over her nation, and that she lost her motivation to fight back after the takeover. But as one of the witch's minions has found Laura after her escape, Manatsu suddenly is blessed with the powers of the sea that allows to her to become Cure Summer, one of the legendary warriors foretold in the legends of the Grand Ocean.

name: The Madame Blanc Mysteries
summary: Jean White is an antiques dealer who runs a successful business with her husband, Rory. But when he suddenly dies and leaves her nearly penniless, Jean relocates to their one remaining asset - a cottage in French antiques hub Saint Victoire - and begins investigating Rory's mysterious death.

name: Anthony Ant
summary: The adventures of Anthony and his friends in the underworld city of Antville.

name: Skyville Live
summary: CMT has paired with Skyville Live to bring you 10 specials celebrating the music of legendary artists. In each of the 10 specials, you'll get to see new collaborations from some of the biggest artists, past and present, all performed pre-pandemic in front of an intimate studio audience at Skyville Live in Nashville. Favorites in entertainment and music featured in the specials include Cyndi Lauper, Graham Nash, the late Gregg Allman, Emmylou Harris, a salute to Jerry Lee Lewis, Martina McBride and more.

name: Queen Victoria: In Her Own Words
summary: An exploration of the queen's life, through her diaries, journals and letters, as well as other items in the royal archives. Narrated by Miriam Margolyes.

name: The Story of the Bat
summary: The story of four young heroes hailing from the prominent families of Wulin; Feng Jun Long, Bao Shao Qing, Xu Ling Xiu and Sima Yan who work together to investigate the famed murderer "Bian Fu (Bat)". In the midst of investigation, they unveil the mystery left behind by the good and evil forces of Jianghu twenty years ago. From constantly suspecting one another to eventually attaining mutual trust and support, the four youths went through numerous tribulations and challenges, bravely pursuing the ideal jianghu and justice of their hearts.

name: Що Коїться!
summary: How the modern youth of Ivano-Frankivsk lives. "Що Коїться!" series is stories of five completely different residents of Ivano-Frankivsk. Against the background of local streets, the characters talk about their everyday life. The youth drama was created by a group of enthusiasts. The organizers say that the plot of the series is completely fictional and does not concern the real life of the actors.

name: Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san
summary: The story is set in Kyoto's "hanamachi" geisha quarter. Here, after geisha finish their work late at night, they spend the night resting at a lodge to prepare for the next day. The story centers on Kiyo, an Aomori native who works as a cook in a geisha lodge in Kyoto after finishing junior high school and leaving home. She also has a friend named Sumire who is a maiko, or apprentice geisha.

previousepisode.name: Dumplings for a Day Off / Sumire's Day Off (Part One) / Sumire's Day Off (Part Two)

name: Wanted: The Simple Life
summary: Chris Bavin helps families sample rural living to see if it could bring them a new lease of life.

name: Toddlers & Tiaras: Where Are They Now?
summary: Across America, little girls and boys compete in pageants in hopes of impressing the judges with their beauty, personality and costumes. Catch up with some of the pageant superstars years later to see what they are up to now.

name: Life Below Zero: Canada
summary: Stories of people, including First Nations people, who live off the grid in remote regions of Northern Canada, and how they spend their day-to-day lives.

name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
summary: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.

name: Den du veit
summary: How high is Norwegian artists' musical IQ? Host Anders Hoff and team captains Silya Nymoen and Jakob Schøyen Andersen test what our artists know about what they actually do, music. The artists are put to a real test in the studio, and viewers at home can join in and guess: What is your musical IQ? Are you a Mozart or a Mads Hansen?

name: Muppet Moments
summary: The shorts will feature the main Muppets cast (including Kermit the Frog, Miss Piggy, Fozzie Bear, Gonzo, Animal, Dr. Bunsen Honeydew, Beaker, Pepe the King Prawn, the Muppet Newsman, Bobo the Bear, Sam the Eagle, Rowlf the Dog, Bubba the Rat, Rizzo the Rat, Foo-Foo and Beauregard) interviewing real kids about various different things, such as apologies, favorite foods and manners.

name: Show by Rock!! Stars
summary: "All stars" season of Show by Rock!! featuring all the bands from previous seasons.

name: Glitch
summary: A young woman joins forces with a UFO enthusiast to investigate her boyfriend's sudden disappearance and stumbles into a wild conspiracy.

name: Winter's Hidden Wonders
summary: Winter pushes wildlife to the extreme. For some, it is a chance to thrive; for others, the only way to escape the icy hold of winter is to shut down every physical system. When spring finally comes, it is a time for celebration for those who managed to survive the most brutal of seasons.

name: Double Cross with Blake Griffin
summary: Double Cross with Blake Griffin serves up an incredibly devious twist as it offers a service to those who are all too often the victims of a prank. Each week, Griffin conspires with people who are tired of being the victim to help them get some sweet revenge on their unsuspecting prankster - by pulling off the ultimate double cross!

name: KL Gangster: Underworld
summary: Shah, heir to the Kg Baru Gangster throne, decides to cut ties with the underworld after falling in love with a girl from a rival gang. Things spin out of control when he's asked to do "one last job" and he unwittingly discovers a plot that will change the fate of the KL Gangsters forever.

name: Fright Club
summary: In a frightening yet friendly competition, paranormal investigators Jack Osbourne and the Ghost Brothers - Dalen Spratt, Marcus Harvey and Juwan Mass - come together to freak each other out with the craziest and creepiest paranormal footage they can find. These guys have each faced their fair share of paranormal disturbances, so they know what's real ... and what's really freaky. It's an uproarious and jaw-dropping battle of the paranormal.

name: Luo Bao Bei
summary: Luo Bao Bei is a British-Chinese animated television series. It is produced by "Magic Mall Entertainment" in Beijing and Cloth Cat Animation, and was distributed by 9 Story Media Group. The show follows Luo Bao Bei, a bright and spirited seven-year-old girl with a vivid imagination, on a quest to understand the world around her. Fantasy and dreams add elements of surrealism. Since then, Luo has acted as a Beijing city spokesperson and road safety icon involved in community outreach programs.

name: La Promesse
summary: On Boxing Day 1999, Charlotte Meyer, an 11-year-old girl, disappears without a trace. Captain Pierre Castaing, in charge of the investigation, fails to find her. A few hundred kilometres away, a young investigator is confronted with a similar disappearance...

name: Interpol
summary: A team of police officers attached to Interpol is tasked with tracking down fugitives and finding missing persons abroad. The protagonists, Louise Lefranc, a cop haunted by the unsolved disappearance of a teenage girl; Captain Kieffer, an Interpol policeman; Myriam Zarka, a  gifted with diplomas; and Lieutenant Marciano, a new recruit who is looking for a second wind ... all will have to unravel affairs with international ramifications that will lead them from Italy to Germany or Tunisia, wherever a French national who has disappeared or has fled may be found.

name: Assembly Required
summary: Assembly Required reunites Tim Allen with Richard Karn in this new competition series that spotlights the best and brightest builders from across the country, at their home workshops, as they compete to breathe new life into everyday household items in desperate need of fixing. This new series will push each contestant to their limits while testing their ability and ingenuity to not only rebuild it but to build it better. In each episode, Allen and Karn will also dive into the unique history around these items to celebrate the men and women who crafted them, and the techniques used.

name: Z biegiem lat, z biegiem dni...
summary: A story about the fate of two Krakow families, the action takes place in the years 1874-1914.

name: Lessons in Chemistry
summary: Set in the early 1950s, Lessons in Chemistry follows Elizabeth Zott, whose dream of being a scientist is put on hold in a society deeming that women belong in the domestic sphere, not the professional one. When Elizabeth finds herself pregnant, alone and fired from her lab, she musters the ingenuity only a single mother has. She accepts a job as a host on a TV cooking show, and sets out to teach a nation of overlooked housewives - and the men who are suddenly listening - a lot more than recipes... all the while craving a return to her true love: science.

name: Fast Foodies
summary: Celebrity guests challenge three gourmet chefs to recreate, then reimagine classic fast foods.

name: EdoMoiselle
summary: Shunsuke works part-time at a cafe owned by his uncle Takehiko. One night, a woman, who is dressed like a traditional oiran (high ranking courtesan), appears in front of him. The woman's name is Senka. Apparently, she just travelled across time from the Edo period to the present day and she looks completely lost. Shunsuke takes her to his uncle's house where he also stays. Senka stays at Takehiko's house and also begins to work part-time at his cafe. Senka gets people's attention due to her appearance and behavior. Meanwhile, Shunsuke goes to the library to find information about Senka. He learns that Senka was a legendary oiran in the Edo period.

name: Seiten wo Tsuke
summary: Eiichi Shibusawa was born in 1840 to a farmer's family. He grew up helping his family with work, which was to manufacture and sell indigo production and also silk farming. He left his hometown at the age of 23 and began working for the government. He later travelled to Paris and learned about banking. Upon his return to Japan, he helped build up the first modern bank in Japan. He eventually became a founder or supporter to about 500 companies and was involved with about 600 public services, including education for women.

name: Das U-Boot
summary:
Submarines today are highly complex machines crammed with technology and weapons. As impressive as their construction is, as terrifying is their destructive power. Hardly any other weapon triggers as many emotions as the submarine. It strikes from ambush and can use nuclear missiles to drag the whole world into the abyss.

Submarines originated from a completely non-military idea, namely to be able to view the world under water. But the interest in the military use of submarines soon prevailed.

name: Pep's
summary: Whether we work there as a teacher, study there or drop our children off there every morning, the school leaves no one indifferent. Depressed teachers, stressed parents and happy schoolchildren, Pep's takes us back into the daily life of this infernal triangle. In front of the gate, in the canteen, in the corridors or in the classrooms, relationships intertwine for the better... and often for the worse!

name: Отпуск
summary: The family of the northerners for the eleventh time comes to rest in the guesthouse to the family of the southerners. Sasha, the eldest son of the northerners, wants to propose to Lucy, the daughter of the southerners, with whom he has been friends since childhood. But Sasha does not yet know that she has a boyfriend. Sasha's mother Larisa, tired of the antics of Seva's unlucky husband, decides to divorce. Seva has time until the end of her vacation to save her marriage. Unlike them, southerners have just begun their relationship. Borya, a poor, but very cunning owner of a guesthouse, recently began to live with the beauty Madina. But the former, the richest man in the city of Taimuraz, is trying with all his might to return her. This is the story of two families, in each of which people are fighting for love.

name: 24/7 FC
summary: Your journey with 1. FC Köln continues - and again it leads into the unknown: In the 2020/21 season, reality is again writing the script for 24/7 FC. For the first time in German professional soccer, the FC stars will even be wired on the pitch. You're closer than ever before!

name: Beauty and the Bullet
summary: The strange death of an influential member of the parliament, who gets poisoned while being a judge of a reality cooking show, leads to a series of puzzling events and chaos throughout the nation. Who is the murderer? Why was she poisoned?

name: Jeet Ki Zid
summary: Inspired from a true story, Jeet Ki Zid is a tale of conviction, persuasion and commitment. It follows the life of a Special forces officer Major Deep Singh who is left paralyzed waist below after fighting the Kargil war, but his army training and never-give-up attitude help him get back to life and eventually on his feet despite all odds.

name: Chazarot
summary: Iris and Tomer are two theater nobodies whose five-year relationship ends in a rough breakup. But just as Tomer leaves the house, he gets a surprising text telling him that Israel's biggest theater is interested in picking up their mutual dream project. Now they must brave working together as exes in the rehearsal room alongside the pair of narcissistic television stars whom the theater insisted on casting for the lead roles in the semi-autobiographical play.

name: Life of Namjoo
summary: Jin Nam Joo is kicked from the first day of the new year to his boyfriend, who he believed was fate. The fortune teller's dad predicts that three men of destiny will appear to his daughter, Jin Nam Joo. A romantic comedy that finds the 'Chin' Nam Joo of life.

previousepisode.name: #53 В поисках Лёши (Никита Никитин, Настя Ли, Хетаг Хугаев, Гудков, BRB)

name: Tónlistarmennirnir Okkar
summary: Tónlistarmennirnir Okkar is a documentary and interview series where Auðunn Blöndal meets some of the country's most beloved musicians, follows them in play and work and reviews their careers.

name: Líf dafnar
summary: Beautiful and personal aspects supervised by Andrea Eyland for most of the first three years of the lives of children and their parents. We follow small and large families and look into their lives and talk to experts about important issues related to these precious early years.

name: 10 Years Younger: Quick Tricks
summary: Cherry Healey delivers some insider beauty and fashion tips on how to roll back the years.

name: Secret Safari: Into the Wild
summary: At Ol Pejeta, Kenya's vast and beautiful wildlife conservancy, viewers are taken inside the lives of an incredible cast of wild animals - from elephants and hippos to lions, hyenas and ostriches.

name: Sing Again
summary: Sing Again is an upcoming program produced by the staff of the 'Sugarman' series which aims to provide a performing stage for singers and stars who never got to see the light of stardom during their days, or stars who were once big names but are now forgotten by today's youths.

name: Half-Fifty
summary: Half-Fifty is a comedy drama about youth and growth, and the series follows a group of 25-year-olds who end up in the world of YouTubers.

name: Mud Mountain Haulers
summary: In the all-new Mud Mountain Haulers, bigger paydays beckon men to risk it all in the kilometre-high Cariboo Mountains of B.C. This character-driven docu-series focuses on one of the most dangerous jobs on land - logging and log hauling - and no one is willing to go steeper or higher than third-generation loggers Craig and Brent Lebeau and their crews. For a decade, the two brothers were at loggerheads, unwilling to cede an inch or a machine to the other. But wicked weather, a series of setbacks, and a declining industry have forced the Lebeau brothers to bury the axe and work together.

name: A Wild Year on Earth
summary: Documentary series charting the planet's most spectacular events of migration, rebirth and transformation. Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. However, in the 21st Century, these patterns are becoming more extreme, less predictable and dangerously unreliable. Across the globe, we witness the drama and the spectacle. No matter what time of year it is, somewhere on Earth something miraculous is happening.

name: This England
summary: This England will tell the tale of some of the most devastating events to ever befall the United Kingdom, and of a Prime Minister leading in these unprecedented times. The drama will trace the impact on Britain from this once in a generation pandemic, and the response of scientists, nurses, and doctors as they worked tirelessly and heroically to contain and overcome the virus. It is based on the first-hand testimony of people from all walks of life; from Number 10 Downing Street, the Department of Health, The Scientific Advisory Group for Emergencies (SAGE), and from hospitals and care homes across the country.

name: Holey Moley Australia
summary:
Holey Moley is a whimsical land where mini golf and massive fun is par for the course!

Australia's most skilled and passionate golfers will come from across the land to take on the most epic mini golf course ever created, but only a new breed of contender will survive this competition.

Towering windmills, fire-breathing dragons, shark-infested lagoons and a giant sausage – it's the course that has everything. No inch of astroturf has been left unturned in creating this unmatched test of precision putting and stamina.

name: Brothers
summary: Love between step-brothers. Love between a teacher and a student. A junior who wants to flirt and a senior who got carried away. Follow the various complicated love stories among friends that are interconnected.

name: Deal Lover
summary: Deal Lover is the story of a homeowner, Grandma Un, whose daughter got a job overseas. Therefore she must sell her house and go to live with his family in London. But selling a home for a homeowner like Grandma Un becomes somewhat unusual. Grandma Un decides to sell the house to Milan, a young blogger and her  younger brother Tokyo. Grandma Un's forgetfulness makes buying the house a mistake after she meets Din who inquires about Un's house after his mother's death. On the day of the contract signing, both Milan and Din show up to make their claim on the house. After quarreling, Un offers for them to try to live in the home together for 7 days. As for Tokyo, Milan's brother met with a close friend until a love develops. Proceeding under the mission to conquer the house How will the story end?

name: Capitani
summary: In a Luxembourg village where everyone is keeping secrets, gruff police inspector Luc Capitani investigates the suspicious death of a 15-year-old girl.

previousepisode.name: Du muss wëssen, wat ass besser

name: Uri and Ella
summary: Uri and Ella are father and daughter dealing with the death of the matriarch, Tami, after battling cancer. Uri, a singer with a long and illustrious career is trying to open the second chapter of his life. Ella, without plans or direction, is looking for herself in between opportunities, men and temporary jobs.

name: First Australians
summary: First Australians chronicles the birth of contemporary Australia as never told before, from the perspective of its first people. First Australians explores what unfolds when the oldest living culture in the world is overrun by the world's greatest empire.

name: Edgar
summary: Although Edgar Aquin can go unnoticed by his appearance, he is a formidable investigator, with an extraordinary sense of observation. With his unconventional methods, sharp instincts and unique logic, he will succeed in proving the guilt of the suspects every time!

name: Mission Millenium : Le Masque de Chac
summary: An adventure game mixing culture, sport and discovery that involves 5 teams of 3 candidates in search of the secrets of a prestigious civilization beyond our borders.

name: Adam Liaw's Roadtrip for Good
summary: In his new series Adam Liaw's Roadtrip for Good, the cook, author and TV presenter visits bushfire-affected regions as they spring back to life. Over four episodes, Adam unearths some of the best food Australia has to offer, making mouth-watering Asian-inspired dishes with the produce he collects along the way. He meets with locals and discovers that these resilient communities are rebuilding and ready to welcome visitors back with open arms.

name: Narrative Telephone
summary: How much does a story change as it gets retold? Introducing Narrative Telephone! It all starts with Matthew Mercer weaving a quick story set in Wildemount. His recording will be sent off to a fellow cast member to be viewed JUST ONCE, and then retold to the best of their recollection. Once the story has passed through each cast member, we'll compare where it starts to where it ends and see just how much the story changes.

name: Robot in Our House
summary: A young man named Youssef works on a project to manufacture a robot with artificial intelligence, and when he succeeds in creating Lazzez and Zumba, his life and the life of his family are quickly turned upside down.

name: Årgang 20
summary: What will the next generation of Danes be like? And which Denmark will they grow up in? 'Year 20' follows four children and their families - from the time the children are born until they turn 18 in 2038.

name: Missie Callcenter
summary: An everyday question, a personal dilemma or a minor annoyance. Welcome to "Mission Call Center", a unique calling center where callers can share their story and where the phone lines are manned by misses with a mission. Véronique De Kock, Ann Van Elsen, Dina Tersago, Celine Van Ouytsel, Anne De Baetzelier, Virginie Claes, Joke Van De Velde, Justine De Jonckheere, Eveline Hoste, Ellen Petri, Lenty Frans, Nele Somers, Cilou Annys and Angelina Flor Pua let not a single topic of callers unspoken and throw everything in the battle to start 2021 with a good feeling. The Masses each followed their own professional path, sharing their personal experiences to guide their interlocutors through each situation. With the necessary humor, honesty and empathy.

name: Alla utom vi
summary: Hilma and Ola are desperately trying to get pregnant. They struggle to achieve the dream of starting a family, while their surroundings get involved with advice on how best to succeed.

name: Lebanon – Borders of Blood
summary: For decades Lebanon has been the epicenter of international unrest. This ambitious project is about the ongoing bloody wars that have plagued the country since the mid-1970s and until today, and how disastrous decisions shaped the destiny of millions in the region, and around the world. For the first time, over 100 interviewees from ALL sides of the conflict in Lebanon, are telling their personal stories that intertwine with the historical events.

name: Saka no Ue no Kumo
summary: The 19th Century was a turbulent one for Japan. Enduring the throes of change brought about by the Meiji era, it still struggled to join the world and be considered a "civilized, modern nation." After 300 years, samurai turned to labor, farmers sought other industries, and technology became king. Saka no Ue no Kumo covers the later years of the Meiji, when Japan—still wrestling with its identity—fought the little discussed Russo-Japanese War. We join the story with brothers Akiyama Yoshifuru and Akiyama Saneyuki, and their friend, the poet Masaoka Shiki, as they face these travails with decided Japanese spirit.

previousepisode.name: The Battle of the Sea of Japan

name: La nuit où Laurier Gaudreault s'est réveillé
summary: The Night Logan Wakes Up is an adaptation of the popular stage play La nuit où Laurier Gaudreault s'est réveillé from playwright Michel Marc Bouchard. The series, which mixes horror, humour and drama, takes place in the early 1990s and follows Mimi and her brother Jules, who are best friends with Logan.

previousepisode.name: La nuit où Laurier Gaudreault s'est réveillé

name: Ina ♥ porno
summary: Ina ♥ porno is an intelligent, thrilling and empowering show about porn and sexuality. Hosted by a Finnish millenial revolutionista and journalist Ina Mikkola, the show is a world tour that explores our sexuality through porn.

name: Really Meet Love That Day
summary: Li Tian Zhen, a newcomer in the workplace with the dream of an architect, and the talented designer Meng Yan grows together and realizes the dreams of their career and life.

name: Always Have, Always Will
summary: Small town girl Fang Li and the stone-faced straight-A student Luo Yan relive their forgotten days from high school after reuniting in college, thus starting their journey of love that's filled with endless bickering.

name: QAnon: The Search for Q
summary: This docuseries takes a step back to examine the who, what, and why behind QAnon.

name: Альманах: Психические расстройства
summary: An anthology of five short films on the topic of mental disorders.

name: Sensei wo Kesu Houteishiki
summary: At a prestigious high school in Tokyo, the third grade D Class consists of high scoring students. This is a group with a history, as all of their previous homeroom teachers have been driven crazy within a short period of time and quit. It turns out that the students in D Class enjoy the sport of pushing teachers to the edge, ultimately watching them descend into mental collapse. They are highly skilled at this game and have yet to lose. Then one day, Tsuneo Yoshizawa appears before the D Class as their new homeroom teacher. Tsuneo Yoshizawa keeps a smile on his face no matter what, somehow enduring their relentless verbal and physical attacks. In frustration, the students' behavior gets worse and the situation escalates. Eventually, they find themselves concocting a plan to kill their teacher.

name: Einfalt með Evu
summary: Eva Laufey emphasizes simple and healthy food that is suitable for modern families where there is not always much time for cooking. Emphasis is placed on good ingredients first and leads to cooking tasty food that nourishes body and soul in a short time.

name: Petits Meurtres en famille
summary: The French adaption of Agatha Christie's mystery novel Hercule Poirot's Christmas.

name: Hunting Fish
summary: Thom Hunt is a great fisherman with many years of experience.This time he wants to leave his comfort zone behind and test himself as an angler.

name: The Masked Singer: Who Are You?
summary: Tune in for an all-star competition as famous singers face off against one another in dazzling head-to-toe costumes.

name: Fixer Upper: Welcome Home
summary: Chip and Jo are back with new ideas for turning outdated homes into jaw-dropping, innovative living spaces. Having expanded their business (and their family), the Gaineses now juggle more while renovating, which keeps things unpredictable.

name: Sex Industry: Uncovered
summary: Exploring different aspects of Britain's burgeoning sex industry. From a wry look at the production of sex toys and Britain's changing desires, to a revealing look behind closed doors of a busy brothel.

name: Allmen
summary: The privateer Johann Friedrich von Allmen is a person who knows how to enjoy life, but unfortunately he lacks one talent for this: dealing with money. Therefore, he gets into a financial crisis, which he tries to master together with his servant Carlos.

previousepisode.name: Allmen und das Geheimnis des Koi

name: A Series of Light
summary: An anthology series which explores the darkest sides of humanity, through technology, connection, intimacy and heartbreak.

name: Homeroom
summary: Rintaro Aida is a handsome teacher. One of his students, Sachiko Sakurai endures unpleasant situations every day. The identity of the person who causes the unpleasantness is not known. Rintaro Aida always saves her from those situations. Because of this, Sachiko Sakurai begins to have feelings for her homeroom teacher. What Sachiko Sakurai does not know is that Rintaro Aida likes her very much and he is behind the unpleasant situations and he does this to save her.

name: Altsasu
summary: A TV series based on the case of eight young people from Alsasua

name: Can't Get You Out of My Head
summary:
We are living through strange days.

Across Britain, Europe and America societies have become split and polarised not just in politics but across the whole culture. There is anger at the inequality and the ever growing corruption - and a widespread distrust of the elites.

And into this has come the pandemic that has brutally dramatised those divisions.

But despite the chaos there is a paralysis - a sense that no one knows how to escape from this.

This new series of films by Adam Curtis tell the story of how we got to this place. And why both those in power - and we - find it so difficult to move on.

The films trace different forces across the world that have led to now, not just in the West, but in China and Russia as well.

It covers a wide range - including the strange roots of modern conspiracy theories, the history of China, opium and opiods, the history of Artificial Intelligence, melancholy over the loss of empire and, love and power. And whether modern culture, despite its radicalism, is really part of the new system of power.

And the films are told in a different way - they are an emotional history of what went on inside the heads of all kinds of people.

Because in the age of the individual - what you felt and what you wanted and what you dreamed of were going to become the driving force across the world.

What was forgotten in that age was that much of what we feel is also formed by the society around us. Above all by the power structures.

And now those structures are decaying - everywhere - their weakness and uncertainty makes us feel empty and frightened of the future.

That is what is paralysing us - and blocking us from imagining different kinds of societies and a better future

Can't Get You Out of My Head is an epic history that shows how and why that happened. How we made this particular world. And that it was not inevitable.

previousepisode.name: Part Six - Are We Pigeon? Or Are We Dancer?

name: Black Bird
summary: Inspired by actual events, when high school football hero, decorated policeman's son and convicted drug dealer Jimmy Keene is sentenced to 10 years in a minimum security prison, he is given the choice of a lifetime — enter a maximum-security prison for the criminally insane and befriend suspected serial killer Larry Hall, or stay where he is and serve his full sentence with no possibility of parole. Keene quickly realizes his only way out is to elicit a confession and find out where the bodies of several young girls are buried before Hall's appeal goes through. But is this suspected killer telling the truth? Or is it just another tale from a serial liar?

name: Bang Baang
summary: Bang Baang is an action-packed murder mystery with a hint of romance. A series of murders take place one after the other and the badass couple, Raghu-Julia remain, in the center of dark secrets, crime, and action trying desperately to solve the case. Amongst all this chaos, their Jodi also takes an unexpected turn when an ex-flame, Meera enters their life. What happens to Raghu and Julia and the circumstances then?

name: Revolving Hearts
summary: After finishing her studies, Bo returns to Thailand and finds out that her boyfriend has married someone else. Wanting to numb the pain, the girl goes to a bar for a drink and almost falls into the clutches of a bad guy. By a lucky chance, she is saved by Thoth. He doesn't know that Bo is the ex - lover of her sister's husband. To protect his sister's marriage, he tries to make Bo fall in love with him and marries her. But what happens when the main character finds out that this was just Thoth's plan? Or will there already be passionate feelings between the characters by then?

name: 54 Days
summary: A two-part programme looking at the pandemic in China and America.

name: BlackSpace
summary: An ordinary morning at a small-town High School turns into a nightmare when anonymous figures in masks have committed a massacre leaving four dead students. Chaos is at its peak. The school is surrounded by police cars. Ambulances and police forces are rushed to the scene, as well as terrified parents and journalists. Rami Davidi (37), a police detective from the special investigations, is one of the first to arrive at the crime scene. After all, this is his high school, the one he attended as a teenager. Along with everyone else he expects to catch the killers still hiding inside the building. But to their surprise, the rescue unit finds only terrified students inside, wounded and reeling with shock, along with four corpses.

name: Joanna Lumley's Home Sweet Home: Travels in My Own Land
summary: After a lifetime of travels that have taken her across the globe, Joanna Lumley is making her most personal journey yet. Over three episodes, she'll travel from the Yorkshire Dales to St Michael's Mount, from the Highlands of Scotland to the cobbles of Coronation Street, retracing old steps, meeting inspiring people, and exploring the wonders of the country she calls home.

name: Simply Raymond Blanc
summary: The chef shares a collection of simple, rustic recipes that can be put together easily, as well as revealing the workings of the world-famous Le Manoir aux Quat'Saisons where he is Chef Patron and which provides much of the fruit and vegetables that go into his dishes.

name: Tom Swift
summary: Follow the adventures of billionaire inventor Tom Swift, who is thrust into a world of sci-fi conspiracy and unexplained phenomena after the shocking disappearance of his father. Tom takes to the road on a quest to unravel the truth, leaving behind the comforts of his usual moneyed lifestyle, all while fighting to stay one step ahead of an Illuminati-scale group hell-bent on stopping him.

name: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here!
summary: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! is the next chapter for Archibald Strutter, a chicken who "yes-and's" his way through life. While his adventures don't always go as planned, Archibald takes it one step at a time with the help of his three siblings, Sage, Finly, and Loy, and his trusty sidekick, Bea.

name: A Girl Like Me
summary: Ban Hua is a beautiful woman who has come close to married bliss three times. But her straight-shooting, frank manner, and explosive temper have meant that every potential relationship ended in disaster and divorce – even though deep down, she is actually very well-meaning and thoughtful. One day, she discovers that she has a rare talent: She can forecast the future through her dreams. She uses this gift to help her family out of a tight spot. But her life changes forever when she meets Rong Xia, a young maverick whose family has befallen a tragic fate. Rong Xia is on the hunt for answers about what happened to his family, as well as clues about his true identity, which has been kept a secret from him all his life. Together, the duo strikes up a partnership, with Ban Hua determined to help Rong Xia learn the truth. But as their relationship deepens, could this be a case of fourth time lucky in love for her?

name: 90 Day Fiancé: Love Games
summary:
The 90 Day Fiancé universe continues to grow with another spinoff: game show Love Games.

The latest show will see 24 couples from the 90 Day universe going head-to-head to answer questions ranging from their juiciest secrets and most annoying habits to just how well they really know each other. Watch a teaser below.

Questions include "What's something your partner thinks they're good at, but really they aren't?" and "If you could date anyone from the 90 Day Fiancé universe other than your partner, who would it be?"

The elimination-style game show features three preliminary rounds of questions before culminating in a finale where viewers' favorite couples compete against each other to win the 90 Day championship trophy.

name: All Our Wrong Todays
summary: All Our Wrong Todays tells the story of Tom Barren, who lives in a world where technology has solved all of humanity's problems — there's no war, no poverty, no under-ripe avocadoes. However, Tom isn't happy, because he's lost the girl of his dreams. So, what do you do when you're heartbroken and have a time machine? You end up in an alternate reality, obviously.

name: Stan Lee's Superhero Kindergarten
summary: Captain Fantastic was the world's greatest superhero… until one epic battle when he collided with his arch-nemesis and an explosion of super-energizing particles rained down on six unsuspecting babies leaving him POWERLESS. Five years later, those babies have developed superpowers and need help learning to control them! Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as a superhero-turned-super-teacher in Kartoon Channel!'s new animated series, Stan Lee's Superhero Kindergarten!

name: Skull Island
summary: Skull Island follows shipwrecked characters desperate to escape the most dangerous place on Earth - a mysterious island home to prehistoric monsters, including the greatest titan of them all, Kong.

previousepisode.name: You'll Never Catch a Monkey That Way

name: Uit de Kleren
summary: 2 strangers. 1 bed. 30 minutes. Without clothes. But what does such an intimate half hour do to two singles on a first date? 50 Flemish singles, who are strangers to each other, literally - expose themselves ...

name: United States of Al
summary: United States of Al is a comedy about the friendship between Riley, a Marine combat veteran struggling to readjust to civilian life in Ohio, and Awalmir ("Al"), the interpreter who served with his unit in Afghanistan and has just arrived to start a new life in America.

name: Irene and Seulgi - Level Up! Thrilling Project
Tomb Raider: The Legend of Lara Croft
summary: Thrust into a high-stakes chase around the world, fearless adventurer Lara Croft confronts her traumatic past while unraveling an ancient mystery.

name: Turquoise Fever
summary: Turquoise Fever follows the Otteson clan in a quest for gems long buried in the Nevada desert. The rewards are great but the risks are high.

name: Line in the Sand
summary: Alon Shenhav, an outstanding detective officer who came from Nahariya and moved to Tel Aviv, is asked to return to his hometown and acts there as a detective officer for a year. When he returns, he discovers that Maor Ezra is a criminal organization operating in the city. Alon understands that in order to fight Ezra, he must first restore the public status of the police in the city.

name: Avatards
summary: Comedy Blap which swaps between obsessive gamers' real and online lives. Meg and Daniel are housemates - and adventurers of Lava Mountain. Things go wrong when Meg's office crush joins the game.

name: Foodtastic
summary: Foodtastic is a build competition series, where teams of contestants are challenged to create whimsical, larger-than-life, Disney-inspired works of art made out of all types of food including everything from cheese and butter to fruits and vegetables. In each self-contained episode, three teams of food artists transform iconic characters into extravagant masterpieces that tell a story from Disney's legendary IP. These food sculptures will be judged purely on their design, technical skills and narrative, and not by taste. Unused food from each competition will be donated to local food banks.

previousepisode.name: The Muppets: A Chicken Day Miracle

name: The Widower
summary: The Widower goes behind the scenes of one of the country's most confounding murder investigations, revealing a tale of evil and a tireless quest for justice in real time. The riveting docuseries features unprecedented and exclusive access to the alleged killer playing cat-and-mouse not just with investigators, but with "Dateline's" cameras.

name: Pacific Rim: The Black
summary: After Kaiju ravage Australia, two siblings pilot a Jaeger to search for their parents, encountering new creatures, seedy characters and chance allies.

name: Jerusalem
summary:
Jerusalem follows events in the lead up to the Jewish fast of Tisha Be'av (the day of mourning over the destruction of the Jewish Temple) and the Muslim celebration of Eid al-Adha (the holiday of the sacrifice) - which by rare circumstance fall on the same day.

Superintendent Amir is a man fluent in Arabic, knowledgeable about Islam and Christianity, and able to walk the tightrope between the different faiths and remain unaffiliated (and yet, affiliated with everyone), all with a single goal in mind: to maintain the status quo, unfortunately at the cost of neglecting his own family. We follow him as he and his fellow officers race to prevent a devastating atrocity in the heart of the ancient Old City.

name: Celebs Go Dating: The Mansion
summary: The Celebrity Dating Agency has a swanky new home, and for the very first time, the celebs and their potential love matches all bed down together in one very plush mansion.

name: Masrah Masr
summary: A collection of comedy theater presents a new type of separate plays in titles and events with each episode.

name: Ultra Violet & Black Scorpion
summary: The series follows Violet Rodriguez, a young Latina who is chosen by a magical luchador mask to be a superhero, like her uncle, Black Scorpion.

name: Søstrene ser på TV
summary: They are rich, unrefined and unfiltered. Sisters Gry and Beatrice have an opinion on everything - but rarely the same.

name: Mitt afro och jag
summary: Four Afro women sit in the hairdresser's chair. For one of the women, the visit to the hairdresser is a life-changing moment, and for another it is a statement. Edit dives deep into all the curls of Afro hair and follows four women's hair journey. The Afro woman's hair is a charged subject and a symbol of so much more than just hair; identity, oppression, belonging and above all pride.

name: WeCrashed
summary: Follow the greed-filled rise and inevitable fall of WeWork, one of the world's most valuable startups, and the narcissists whose chaotic love made it all possible.

previousepisode.name: The One With All the Money

name: World War 2 from Above
summary: Battlefield historians and military experts utilise cutting-edge, drone-mounted technology to re-examine some of the Second World War's most iconic sites.

name: Rehab Addict Rescue
summary: Nicole Curtis is back to rescue overwhelmed do-it-yourselfers in Detroit who feel they're out of options on restoring their historic homes. With a mix of resourcefulness and sweat equity, she shares her secrets to put them on the path to their dream home.

name: La Suerte De Loli
summary: The life of Loli, a professional and independent woman, takes an unexpected turn when her best friend, Mariana, dies. She receives an inheritance that she does not think she can handle, but shows her that the true meaning of success is in family and love. Suddenly, she must take over as foster mom for Sam and Nicky, Mariana's children, and counts on the help of Rafael Contreras, her boss at the radio station. He is a man with whom she collides professionally and, despite all efforts, with whom she ends up falling in love.

name: We Are: The Brooklyn Saints
summary: A Brooklyn youth football program and its selfless coaches provide a safe haven for kids to compete and learn lessons that will take them far in life.

name: The Brilliant World of Tom Gates
summary: Tom Gates is a boy who is more focused on doodling and biscuits than his school work. His life is full of beady eyed teachers like Mr. Fullerman, his school friends, the annoying Marcus Meldrew and grumpy sister Delia!

name: Love Scene Number
summary: There are a few turning points in a woman's life; a new job, marriage, giving birth. However, dating, love and sex never become easier regardless of how old you are. This is a drama needed by women nowadays that have so much to say, but have no one to talk to. It brings up deep topics people are curious and want to hear about. Four inflection points in life; 23, 29, 35, 42. We challenge ourselves to tell a promiscuous story that other dramas couldn't through the four stories about four people of different ages.

name: Heart & Soul
summary: Go behind the scenes with the cast of Attaway General Season 2 as they dig deep into pressing topics like skincare, social media, and more!

name: Farzar
summary: Prince Fichael lives in a human colony on an alien world and vows to rid the planet of evil — but then learns his dad's the biggest evildoer of them all.

name: College Romance
summary: Three best friends look for love, laughs and some lifelong memories while attending college together.

name: The Disappearance of Shannon Matthews
summary:
Series about the disappearance of nine-year-old Shannon Matthews in Yorkshire in 2008, an investigation that gripped the nation, which turned out to be a hoax kidnapping plot devised by her mother. 

Featuring exclusive interviews with Shannon's best friend, members of the local community, and the police officers who eventually found her, the programme reveals the remarkable truth of what really happened.

name: Adrian Dunbar: My Ireland
summary: Actor Adrian Dunbar reconnects with his roots as he travels around the wild and rugged Irish coast.

name: Всемирные игры разума
summary: Super-erudites ... How powerful are they? Let's test the power of their intellect in the studio of our program and find out if such a super-erudite can compete with professionals "on their field". The honor of erudites is defended by experts Anatoly Wasserman, Rovshan Askerov and Olga Uspanova.

previousepisode.name: Главное, чтобы ты меня не опрокинул!

name: Operation Ouchtastic!
summary: Dr Chris, Dr Xand and Dr Ronx delve into the Operation Ouch! archives, to celebrate your incredible body.

name: Pepe Carvalho
summary: The adventures of the famous detective immortalized in the Manuel Vazquez Montalban's novels.

name: Open Studio with Jared Bowen
summary: Executive Arts Editor Jared Bowen is the Emmy award-winning host of the weekly television series, Open Studio with Jared Bowen, which takes viewers inside the creative process, offering a blend of profiles, performances, and contemporary exhibitions by artists in Greater Boston, New England, and across the country.

name: Talay Luang
summary: A strange man with amnesia appears on an island; there he meets Moya, begins to fall in love and starts building her an island resort. Against the warnings of her best friend, Moya starts to fall in love with him too. However just as their love blooms, a pregnant woman arrives claiming the man is her husband. She takes him back. So Moya tries to forget him, but he returns with memories intact as a player.

name: Temptation of Wife
summary: One night Goo Eun Jae got drunk and Jung Gyo Bin took this opportunity to take advantage of her. Eun Jae and Gyo Bin got married but their marriage is not a very blissful marriage. Eun Jae's best friend, Shin Ae Ri, openly flirts with Gyo Bin in front of Eun Jae. Gyo Bin decided that he did not want to remain married to Eun Jae and tried to kill her. Eun Jae was presumed to have drown and died. Gyo Bin thought he was successful in killing Eun Jae and moved on with Ae Ri. Months later, Eun Jae is back for revenge but she presumes the identity of another woman, Min So Hee, who had killed herself. How will Gyo Bin react to a girl who looks exactly like his presumed dead wife, Eun Jae? Will he be tempted by So Hee?

name: Strange Creatures
summary: The amazing thing about nature is the number of ways it continues to surprise us - and in the case of these unique creatures, it appears we're barely scratching the surface. Spend some time in the company of nature's evolutionary mavericks.

name: Focus Ontario
summary: Focus Ontario is the only place to turn for hot political debates, and the players at Queen's Park know it. This half-hour public affairs show has been a program of record for nearly 25 years.

name: Top Gear America
summary: The world's most popular motoring show comes to MotorTrend. Based on the original motoring series by the BBC, this version pays homage to the legacy of the Top Gear brand with a few original ideas from the minds at MotorTrend.

name: Serge le Mytho
summary: Portrait of a guy who tells stories, played by the hilarious Jonathan Cohen.

name: Caméra café 2, la boîte du dessus
Caméra café
summary: The hit comedy about the world of work is back with a whole new twist! Whether it's social media, the environment, or crisp gossip, there's no shortage of hilarious discussions in front of the coffee machine.

name: Barbaroslar: Akdeniz'in Kılıcı
summary: "Barbaroslar Akdeniz'in Kılıcı" is a Turkish historical drama series that follows the life and adventures of the Barbarossa brothers, Oruç and Hızır, who were Ottoman privateers and admirals in the 16th century. The series portrays their military campaigns against various European powers, as well as their personal lives and relationships.

name: Pepe Carvalho
summary: Poor TV series based on crime novels of the famous Catalan writer Manuel Vasquez Montalban. It is an Italian-French-Spanish co-production in six episodes, and two products made in France, two in Spain and two in Italy.

name: Un gars, une fille
summary: A French couple in their thirties deals with the every day hassles of life together.

name: The Lost Ones
summary: The Lost Ones are stories of people who were born in the wrong place at the wrong time. Their individual fates give insight into big, dramatic events in world history.

previousepisode.name: Henry de Monfreid - Grandeur et décadence d'un écrivain corsaire

name: Brambly Hedge
summary: Adapted from the best selling books from Jill Barklem. The mouse families of the hedge share seasonal adventures, mishaps and marriages in eight exquisite half-hour films. Young Wilfred Toadflax and Primrose Woodmouse lead us through the travails, together with a regular cast which includes Basil, Lady Daisy, Mrs. Eyebright and Poppy, Mr. and Mrs. Toadflax, and Mr. and Mrs. Apple.

name: The Chef
summary: When Nimrod is fired from his cushy high-tech job, he must find a way to restore his crumbled self-esteem and provide for his family. Rejection after rejection results in dwindling finances and forces him to accept his only offer—in the kitchen of an upscale restaurant, run by one of Tel Aviv's most renowned chefs, a bachelor at the height of his professional career. Joining them is Sara, an exceptionally talented young chef who came from London just to work at the famed restaurant. Sara's charm ignites a new energy in the restaurant and casts both men under her spell. Dori attempts to win her heart by taking on the role of mentor, while Nimrod decides to fight for her at all costs. The unexpected love triangle forces all three to overcome their fears and anxieties and prepare for a new path.

name: One Page Love
summary: Winter of 17 years old. Akari Mizusa, who is good at drawing, fell in love with Ikumi Morita, the son of the inn, on an island he visited on a family trip. While watching the Selene meteor shower once every four years, they will see each other's feelings. On the day of the meteor shower after four years, I went to the high pledge of appointment, but it appeared that Hoshino had a camera with Hoshino. Akari's love begins by the sketchbook.

name: Kapten Klänning - polischef och våldtäktsman
summary: Karl Göran Gustav Lindberg is a Swedish convicted serial rapist and a former police chief. He effectively served 2/3rd of a six-year prison sentence in Saltvik Prison for numerous sex crimes

name: Fra bølle til bestevenn
summary: What do you do when your furry best friend bites, barks and is a bully? We meet six desperate dog owners with dogs who have habits they cannot get a handle on. With the help of intensive training with dog trainer Maren Teien Rørvik, they will try to turn these rowdy dogs into good best friends.

previousepisode.name: José, Gaëtan et Gladys / Audrey et Thomas

name: De bachelorette
summary: De bachelorette is about romance, rivalry and, quite possibly, true love! Belgium's most eligible bachelorette, Elke Clijsters, is in search of the man of her dreams and hopefully her groom-to-be in this hit reality series. Our bachelorette is ready to find love and will embark on a romantic journey as she meets 20 handsome bachelors, all vying to win her heart. The guys compete for the bachelorette's affection via individual and group dates involving local and far-flung romantic encounters and adventures. As the bachelorette narrows the field and the number of men dwindles, romance and tensions will rise. At the end of her romantic voyage, if she has found Mr. Right, will there be a proposal — and from whom?

name: Salary Lupin ATEEZ
summary: This time, the members of ATEEZ have turned into employees at an eccentric company, which goes by the name of 'ATEEZ Holdings'. The series will be called Salary Lupin ATEEZ, a play on a popular Korean slang term which refers to employees who are lackluster at work but who still take home their salaries on the dot.

name: Ugly Alert
summary: Gong Joon Soo (Im Joo Hwan) is a man who has had a rough life and early on had to fend for himself. He takes the blame for a murder his brother commits and serves time in prison. There he learns to sew and acquires a trade. After discharged from the prison, his newly acquired skills give him a job in a fashion company and works for Na Do Hee (Kang So Ra), the goody-good daughter of the fashion company which was built by her grandfather. Meanwhile, Gong Joon Soo's father was married to Jin Joo (Kang Byul)'s mother, both families learns how to understand each other and become a family even though they are not related by blood.

name: KochiKame: Tokyo Beat Cops
summary: Ryoutsu, being an underpayed policeman, is always coming up with ways to make some quick money. But in the end, his plans which are ridiculous from the beginning always go wrong and land him in big trouble.

name: 100 000 минут вместе
summary: The series will tell the story of a couple who, after 10 years of marriage, were locked in quarantine for 69 days in their own home. He is a successful pilot, she is a confident fitness trainer. Will these two leaders be able to pass all the tests of self-isolation?

name: Reset
summary: Dexter Thomas reveals the untold stories of the video game industry and meets people changing how we play today.

name: Ghum Hai Kisi Ke Pyaar Mein
summary:
A young police officer loved a woman, promising to marry her. But the word given to the deceased boss connects his fate with the daughter of the deceased man. Duty obliges a guy to obey his conscience, and he marries a young lady, although he feels feelings for his beloved. A valiant policeman is obliged to forget about his love, so as not to destroy his forced marriage. A spouse has to live with a man whose heart is occupied with another woman. But the girl tries to get used to the flow of her new life and does everything to earn the respect of her husband.

Past promises made to a beloved girl torment the soul of a policeman, but he could not do otherwise. Every day, the couple gets used to a new life, where there are no mutual feelings. But gradually, the wife falls in love with her own husband, and realizes that she is ready to earn his love, despite the rival who is deeply embedded in his heart. Soon the faithful begins to realize that the old feelings for the beloved begin to evaporate, and a strong attraction to his wife makes it clear,

name: Beyaz Yalan
summary: They say people were couple created... Who Alara and Melek side by side saw, could have sworn the truth of this promise... These two young girls, they seemed to copy each other... The only thing that different was, was their destiny... Alara was born with a silver spoon in her mouth... she has everything you could imagine, except for the freedom... Melek had opened her eyes into poverty... She was beautiful, she was good hearted, she was hard-working, ambitious... Perhaps the only thing she needed, her unsmiling face's luck! "White Lie", the intersection of these two young girl's life ... the story of Alara's freedom, and Melek's story of a game that promises a chance to wait for life...

name: In aller Freundschaft – Die jungen Ärzte
summary: The spin-off to the original series In aller Freundschaft focuses on the young doctors in a fictional clinic in Erfurt.

name: The 3Bs You Shouldn't Date
summary: Kobayashi Haruka fell in love before finding out that her boyfriend was actually a married man. At that time, a regular customer predicts that she will wind up meeting 3 different men. She begins encountering them just as predicted. There's the hairdresser Shintaro, the band vocalist Yu, and the bartender Yoshi. What will come of these fateful encounters?

name: Muppet Babies: Show and Tell
summary:
Muppet Babies: Show and Tell is a short-form series featuring the Muppet characters from Disney Junior's Muppet Babies.

Designed to promote the new Disney series and introduce the characters to audiences, the series premiered online with exclusive debuts of episodes on multiple websites on March 1, 2018 followed by a wider release online and airings on Disney Junior starting on March 2, 2018.

In the shorts, viewers "get to know the Muppet Babies and their environment."

previousepisode.name: Kermit and Piggy's Show and Tell

name: Gullak
summary: Santosh Mishra, an employee at the electricity division, leads a content life with his wife and sons. However, their everyday banter strengthens their relationship.

name: Bump Birth Baby
summary: Series in which mums and mums-to-be film their own stories for social media.

name: Sonic Prime
summary: Sonic Prime draws upon the keystones of the brand and features the "Blue Blur" of video game fame in a high-octane adventure where the fate of a strange new multiverse rests in his gloved hands. Sonic's adventure is about more than a race to save the universe, it's a journey of self-discovery and redemption.

name: Lovers in Prague
summary: Jae Hee, a diplomat in Prague, getting over a break-up meets police detective Sang Hyun and a romance blossoms. Jae Hee is the daughter of the Korean President and has to maintain a low profile. Jae Hee's ex, Young Woo and Sang Hyun's ex, Hye Joo make things complicated with secrets surrounding them. With the differences in social status, Jae Hee and Sang Hyun have to fight to see if the love that started in Prague can be overcome from what is trying to keep them apart.

name: Fling at Convenience Store
summary: Arriving at work at the convenience store to replace the salesperson, Joo Ah recognizes a guy she ran into on the street. He is very grateful to her, he needs to leave the store to get the prize. Joo Ah remains to work in the store and meets young guys, there are four of them. They are all with different personalities, cute, funny, charismatic, cocky and charming. Now Joo Ah has a job and she needs to work conscientiously to become a worthy employee, but what kind of work is there and how can she resist when four handsome men simultaneously show her attention.

name: Solos
summary: Solos is a dramatic and thought-provoking anthology series that explores the deeper meaning of human connection, as explored through the lens of the individual.

name: Extra Life: A Short History of Living Longer
summary: Extra Life: A Short History of Living Longer examines the science and medical innovations that conquered some of the world's deadliest diseases and doubled life expectancies for many across the globe.

name: All American: Homecoming
summary: All American: Homecoming follows a young tennis hopeful from Beverly Hills and an elite baseball player from Chicago as they contend with the high stakes of college sports, while also navigating the highs, lows and sexiness of unsupervised early adulthood at a prestigious Historically Black College.

name: Shock Docs
summary: Each installment of Travel Channel's Shock Docs goes to the heart of a true American horror story – and a peek into history. We travel across the country to uncover the best-documented paranormal encounters – tales recorded on video and audio that capture the raw terror of an encounter with evil. Additional Shock Docs on the slate for later this fall will delve into the true-life hauntings of the Amityville Horror House and The Exorcism of Roland Doe.

name: Psycho
summary: Your brother can't sleep, your neighbor drinks too much, your boss thinks she's great. Many of us have people in our lives who exhibit psychological peculiarities to a greater or lesser extent. But we rarely talk about it. Because we don't know how. In Psycho, people talk about what it's like to break up or to experience the world as an autistic person. And experts help us understand.
